summary: Join our AI for Executive Decision-Making Training Course and master the art of using AI to enhance strategic decisions and drive organizational success.
lede: Executive decision-making training helps leaders structure high-stakes choices, weigh trade-offs, and explain their rationale. Designed for executives, senior managers, and others who shape strategy, it covers strategic framing, assessing costs, risks, and benefits, comparing options under constraints, and building business cases. Participants also explore decision biases, uncertainty, and communicating choices to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or influence high-level decisions across various sectors. It's tailored for those accountable for outcomes and responsible for shaping organizational strategies.
audience: Public sector decision-makers and policy leads
NGO executive directors and program leads
modules: Identifying Costs, Risks, and Hidden Impacts
Building and Defending Executive Business Cases
Decision Biases and Leadership Blind Spots
Managing Risk and Uncertainty in Executive Choices
Communicating and Defending Decisions to Stakeholders
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in leadership roles and a basic understanding of strategic planning and financial management. Familiarity with organizational decision-making processes is recommended.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
